provenance.source: CGI art. 197 (bareme, decote, plafonnement du quotient familial); loi de finances pour 2026; LegiFiscal bareme 2026; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, France
provenance.notes: The 2026 bareme, the decote formula and the quotient familial cap were read on 31 August 2026. The employee social contribution rates other than CSG and CRDS are a documented approximation, not a statutory figure.

omissions: The prelevement a la source rate is not modelled; this computes the annual liability, not the monthly withholding.
The CDHR differential contribution ensuring a minimum 20% rate on very high incomes is not modelled.
Only the standard 10% abattement is applied. Frais reels are not modelled.
Reductions and credits d'impot (garde d'enfants, dons, emploi a domicile) are not modelled.

bareme.note: Applied to the quotient familial, that is taxable income divided by the number of parts, and the result is then multiplied back by the number of parts.

abattement.note: A flat 10% deduction for professional expenses, with a floor and a ceiling. You may claim actual expenses instead, which this app does not model.

quotientFamilial.note: One part for a single person, half a part for each of the first two children and a full part from the third. The tax saving from each additional half-part is capped.

decote.note: Where the tax before decote is under the ceiling, the decote reduces it by the amount less 45.25% of the tax. It phases the tax in gently at the bottom of the scale.

cehr.note: An exceptional contribution on high incomes, charged on fiscal reference income rather than on the tax.

socialContributions.note: CSG and CRDS are charged on 98.25% of gross pay. Only 6.8 of the 9.2 CSG points are deductible from taxable income, so part of a social contribution is itself taxed.

regions.name: France metropolitaine
regions.note: The bareme is national. Overseas departments have rate reductions that are not modelled.

inputSchema.label: Salaire brut (per month)
inputSchema.help: Gross monthly salary before any deduction.

inputSchema.label: Prelevement a la source (per month)
inputSchema.help: Income tax withheld at source during the year, for the final comparison.

inputSchema.label: Nombre de parts (quotient familial)
inputSchema.help: Your taxable income is divided by the number of parts, taxed, and then multiplied back. Each half-part saves tax, but the saving is capped at 1.807 EUR. Married and PACS couples file jointly, which is out of scope here.

inputSchema.label: Versements PER deductibles
inputSchema.help: Deductible contributions to a plan d'epargne retraite, within your available allowance. This app does not compute your plafond.
